items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez spent eight months in jail in Mexico and only got out a couple of months ago.
items.quote: Daniel Rodriguez is coming back into this fight after spending 8 months in jail in Mexico.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez lost 15 pounds of muscle and barely trained while in jail.
items.quote: he lost 15 lbs of muscle. Barely trained at all.

items.claim: Uros Medic holds a significant speed advantage over Daniel Rodriguez in hand speed, movement, decision making, and reaction time.
items.quote: Uros Medic is way faster than him just in general. Like, he lands faster. He has a speed advantage in his hands for sure... he has a speed advantage with his movement, with his decision making, with his vision.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez has shown good recoverability throughout most of his career, notably coming back after being finished against Kevin Holland.
items.quote: he's shown good recoverability throughout most of his career, honestly. Notably, in that Kevin Holland fight recently, he was completely done in that fight.
